title: More Tokens, Lower Precision: Towards the Optimal Token-Precision Trade-off in KV Cache Compression
authors: Jiebin Zhang; Dawei Zhu; Yifan Song; Wenhao Wu; Chuqiao Kuang; Xiaoguang Li; Lifeng Shang; Qun Liu; Sujian Li
venue_full: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
affiliations: MOE Key Laboratory of Computational Linguistics, Peking University
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, KV cache compression, Quantization, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: The KV cache memory usage becomes a critical bottleneck for long-context LLM inference, and existing methods treat token pruning and precision quantization as orthogonal, under-explored dimensions.
problem_statement.zh: KV cache 記憶體佔用成為長 context LLM 推理的關鍵瓶頸，而現有方法將 token 剪枝與精度量化視為相互獨立、探索不足的兩個維度。

key_innovation.en: Quantized pruning, a strategy that integrates KV pruning and KV quantization to balance token count and precision, allowing for more tokens to be stored at lower bit-precision within a fixed memory budget.
key_innovation.zh: 量化剪枝（quantized pruning）策略：整合 KV 剪枝與 KV 量化，在固定記憶體預算內以較低 bit 精度儲存更多 token，從而在 token 數量與精度之間取得平衡。

baselines_compared: StreamingLLM, H2O, SnapKV, PyramidKV, Ada-KV, HeadKV, FlexGen, KIVI, KVQuant

key_improvements.en: Significant enhancement in long-context performance, particularly in retrieval tasks; 4x tokens in 4-bit precision outperforms 1x tokens in 16-bit precision.
key_improvements.zh: 長 context 效能顯著提升，尤其在檢索任務上表現突出；以 4-bit 精度存放 4x token 的效果優於以 16-bit 精度存放 1x token。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, Long-context Retrieval, Summarization, Code Completion
